## Retrieving Paper Publishing Date

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Script: retrieving_publishing_date.R
# Purpose: Retrieve missing publication dates for each PubMed PMID
#          using API and append to dataset
# Input:   data/raw/pubmed.rds — PubMed metadata with missing PubDate
# Output:  data/raw/pubmed.rds — same file, now with PubDate column added
# Dependencies: xml2, httr, here
# Note: For now, this is for testing purpose only, since the retrieval 
#       needs to be based on the predicted dataset
# ============================================================
```

```{r}
# Load local project-aware file path utility
library(here)

# Load dataset containing PubMed IDs (PMID)
data <- readRDS(here("data/raw/prediction/df_sample_for_prediction.Rds"))

# Preview data structure to confirm presence of PMID column
head(data)
```

```{r}
library(xml2)  # For parsing XML responses from NCBI
library(httr)  # For making HTTP requests

# Month abbreviation to numeric lookup table
month_lookup <- c(
  Jan = "01", Feb = "02", Mar = "03", Apr = "04", May = "05", Jun = "06",
  Jul = "07", Aug = "08", Sep = "09", Oct = "10", Nov = "11", Dec = "12"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Function: fetch_pubdate
# Purpose:  Query PubMed API for publication date of a given PMID
# Input:    pmid — a single PubMed ID (character or numeric)
# Output:   a formatted string in "YYYY-MM-DD" format or NA if unavailable
# ------------------------------------------------------------
fetch_pubdate <- function(pmid) {
  # Construct API URL for fetching article metadata
  url <- paste0(
    "https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi",
    "?db=pubmed&id=", pmid, "&retmode=xml"
  )
  
  # Attempt to query and parse the response XML
  res <- tryCatch(read_xml(GET(url)), error = function(e) NA)

  # Proceed only if API call succeeded
  if (!is.na(res)) {
    node <- xml_find_first(res, "//PubDate")
    if (!is.na(node)) {
      year  <- xml_text(xml_find_first(node, ".//Year"))
      month <- xml_text(xml_find_first(node, ".//Month"))
      day   <- xml_text(xml_find_first(node, ".//Day"))
      
      # Convert abbreviated month to numeric
      if (month %in% names(month_lookup)) {
        month <- month_lookup[month]
      }
      
      # Default missing components to "NA"
      return(paste(year, ifelse(month == "", "NA", month), ifelse(day == "", "NA", day), sep = "-"))
    }
  }
  return(NA)  # If any part of the process fails, return NA
}

data <- readRDS(here("data/raw/prediction/df_sample_for_prediction.Rds"))

# Initialize PubDate column with NA values
data$PubDate <- NA

# Loop through each row and retrieve publication date from API
for (i in seq_len(nrow(data))) {
  pmid <- data$PMID[i]
  pubdate <- fetch_pubdate(pmid)
  data$PubDate[i] <- pubdate
  
  # Console feedback for tracking progress
  cat(sprintf("[%d/%d] PMID: %s | PubDate: %s\n", i, nrow(data), pmid, pubdate))
  
  # Respect NCBI's rate limit (~3 requests/sec)
  Sys.sleep(0.34)
}
```

```{r}
# Save updated dataset back to file
output_csv <- here("data/raw/prediction/df_sample_with_pubdate.csv")
write_csv(data, output_csv)

cat("Done. Output saved to: ", output_csv, "\n")
```
